subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` preserve its current automatic embedded fallback after an ambiguous Gateway disconnect, or adopt this PR’s recovery-first, fail-closed default with `--rerun-on-ambiguous` as the opt-in escape hatch?
rationale: This is not merely a mechanical fix: it intentionally changes the result and automation contract for existing CLI users after an uncertain disconnect, including delivery and side-effect trade-offs.

options.title: Keep the current fallback default
options.body: Do not merge the fail-closed default yet; preserve automatic isolated-session reruns until a maintainer explicitly sponsors a recovery-first contract.

options.title: Approve recovery-first by default
options.body: Accept that ambiguous disconnects stop safely unless recovery succeeds, and require focused live evidence for success, terminal failure, cache miss, and explicit rerun paths.

options.title: Split behavior by invocation mode
options.body: Adopt recovery-first for delivery-oriented runs while preserving the current interactive fallback until its stdout and streaming trade-off is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Keep the current fallback default
recommendation.body: Do not merge the fail-closed default yet; preserve automatic isolated-session reruns until a maintainer explicitly sponsors a recovery-first contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged containment change defines the current fallback policy and makes this person the strongest history-based routing candidate.
